purpose: Transparent regression probes for lexical routing boundaries across global and repository-scoped skills.
construction: The original corpus was independently authored before the 2026-08-08 router hardening without copying lifecycle-evaluations.json wording. New-skill boundary probes are added when ownership changes. After adoption every case is a development regression, not a blind or behavioral evaluation. The catalog-* cases were added on 2026-09-02 when the catalog gained stack, security-tool, and workflow skills. The catalog-19 to catalog-23 cases were added on 2026-09-02 with the kaggle, hf, playwright, colab, and acli tool skills, when google-workspace-cli and google-cloud-operations were renamed to gws and gcloud. The catalog-24 to catalog-27 cases were added on 2026-09-03 with the google-cloud, google-ads, google-analytics, and google-developer catalog skills. Catalog-46 was added on 2026-09-03 for GitHub Agentic Workflows with the Copilot engine.
proof_boundary: Routable cases test deterministic ranking against the complete stored names and descriptions. They do not prove that a host includes every skill, preserves full descriptions within its metadata budget, abstains correctly, selects semantically, follows pressure contracts, or uses tools safely; those boundaries require actual-host discovery and separate behavioral evaluation.
